description: Source code for STM32F10x GPIO firmware functions, including GPIO initialization, deinitialization, read/write operations, pin remapping, and configuration functions.

methods.name: GPIO_DeInit
methods.description: Resets specified GPIO peripheral registers to default reset values.

methods.name: GPIO_AFIODeInit
methods.description: Resets the AFIO (Alternate Function IO) registers to default reset values.

methods.name: GPIO_Init
methods.description: Initializes GPIOx peripheral according to specified parameters.

methods.name: GPIO_StructInit
methods.description: Fills GPIO_InitTypeDef structure with default values.

methods.name: GPIO_ReadInputDataBit
methods.description: Reads the input port pin value.

methods.name: GPIO_ReadInputData
methods.description: Reads the entire input data port.

methods.name: GPIO_ReadOutputDataBit
methods.description: Reads the output port pin value.

methods.name: GPIO_ReadOutputData
methods.description: Reads the entire output data port.

methods.name: GPIO_WriteBit
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific port bit.

methods.name: GPIO_Write
methods.description: Writes data to the entire GPIO port.

methods.name: GPIO_EventOutputConfig
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin as Event output source.

methods.name: GPIO_PinRemapConfig
methods.description: Remaps GPIO pins to alternate functions.

methods.name: GPIO_EXTILineConfig
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin as external interrupt line source.

methods.name: GPIO_ETH_MediaInterfaceConfig
methods.description: Configures Ethernet media interface mode (MII or RMII).
